## Passages
RESULT [weeds]: At a matched 15 W budget, YOLO11s INT8 ran at 145.82 fps and 0.0767 J per inference on Orin Nano Super, against 80.90 fps and 0.1814 J on AGX Orin. INT8 was the fastest and most energy-efficient precision, with detection accuracy retention held to a mAP drop of 0.03 or less. Internal Jetson power telemetry was biased by -1.988 W against the external meter.
US [weeds]: The cleanest published deployment numbers for our exact dataset on Jetson. The loop's promotion gate could require the INT8 TensorRT export to lose no more than about 0.03 mAP, and a promoted model to fit the robot's latency budget, not only to win on holdout mAP. It is a template for measuring the laser car's detector honestly: engine-level against end-to-end timing, with an external power meter.
CORRECTION [weeds]: Confirmed: YOLO11s INT8 at matched 15 W runs at 145.82 fps and 0.0767 J on Orin Nano Super vs 80.90 fps and 0.1814 J on AGX Orin; INT8 drops in mAP50-95, mAP50 and AR100 are each at most 0.03; INA260 external sensor; internal-minus-external bias is -1.988 W (76,691 paired samples).
